scope: Illustrative, source-addressed event leads comparable to the BVVC × School.House National Security Founders' Assembly. This is not a census, an attendance register, a contract join, a misconduct allegation or an accepted canonical hop graph.
evidence_rule: Organizer announcement is evidence of a planned event, not that it occurred. Organizer retrospective supports the organizer's report of a held event; published categories do not identify unnamed individuals. Named companies appear only where specifically named. No contract, award, investment or causal link is inferred from a shared room.

events.title: BVVC National Security Founders' Assembly
events.established: The organizer advertises fifteen company pitches, a demo floor, founder tables and introductions at mHUB. This is a scheduled event as of November 2, not an attendance record.
events.unknown: The public listing does not identify all fifteen companies or prove attendance, subsequent investment, government procurement or influence.

events.title: MassChallenge Dual-Use Symposium
events.established: The organizer advertises startup pitches, government and industry talks, networking, and coordinated office hours. Its program lists represented organizations, not verified attendees.
events.unknown: Speaker appearances, private meetings, contract awards and later commercial outcomes remain unverified before the event.

events.title: SVDG Situation Room: Advanced Manufacturing
events.established: SVDG reports hosting a closed-door advanced-manufacturing dinner bringing together these participant categories; its calendar dates the event October 13.
events.unknown: A named attendee roster, discussion content, agreements and procurement consequences are not supplied.

events.title: SVDG Oceans Blue Tech Investor Tour
events.established: SVDG reports two days of site visits, on-water demonstrations and meetings between capital providers, technology companies and government representatives.
events.unknown: The organizer's summary does not establish that any participant invested, placed an order or awarded a contract.

events.title: Defending the Next Horizon 2.0
events.established: SVDG reports an invited technology showcase alongside Fed Supernova, with more than 200 senior leaders from government, military, investment and industry.
events.unknown: The broad attendee estimate is organizer-reported. It does not identify individual meetings, follow-on financing or procurement actions.

events.title: The Future of Defense Tech
events.established: SVDG's executive director describes a small, day-long curated matchmaking conference between selected defense-technology companies and institutional investors.
events.unknown: The published account does not name each company/investor pairing or substantiate any financing outcome.

events.title: The Future of NatSec100
events.established: SVDG reports a curated event hosted at Franklin Templeton with RTX Ventures and explicitly names eight presenting or participating companies.
events.unknown: The account does not establish a government award, investment or individual interaction for any listed company.

sources.label: SVDG NatSec100 event retrospective and company names

events.title: Army FUZE: Presentation & Private Capital Roundtable
events.format: Government briefing and off-record investor roundtable
events.established: SVDG reports a presentation explaining Army FUZE's venture-backed-innovation engagement, followed by an off-the-record discussion with private-capital participants.

events.title: Missions + Markets #03: Inside the NatSec100
events.established: The SVDG retrospective identifies Cape, Govini and Shield AI demonstrating technology and describes a subsequent networking opportunity.
